thesis: The Atlas ML model continues to strongly favor mining stocks, particularly those involved in diversified metals, copper, and gold. The top picks include AbraSilver Resource (ABRA.TO), Copper Fox Metals Inc. (CUU.V), and Hercules Metals (BIG.V), all showing high ML scores and strong predicted returns. These companies are primarily focused on diversified metals and gold, aligning well with current market conditions that favor stability and growth potential in these sectors. No concrete bearish news was found on any wired oracle assets outside the top-N, so no shorts were opened this run.
